name: plane_soft_rubber_stick_slip_5n
parameter_origin: Illustrative synthetic values; not measured properties of a named commercial material.
material_label: Soft rubber-like solid, stick-slip at 5 N
model_notes: Load-controlled at 5 N; travel is an outcome.

Inertia is switched on only across the slide onset, where the interface leaves stick globally and the coefficient falls 0.60 -> 0.45. That drop has no static equilibrium path, which is what stopped every quasi-static run.
Results inside the transient window are dynamic. The shared suite declares inertial stick-slip out of scope; this setup deliberately studies it.
